# live-codebase

> A small reference service that shows shipping, observability, feature flags and permissioned data access in concrete code.

`livesvc` is a standard-library WSGI service with two listeners (public and admin). It covers structured JSON logs with key and pattern redaction, W3C `traceparent` tracing, Prometheus metrics, liveness versus readiness with time-boxed dependency checks, SIGTERM drain, percentage feature flags with deterministic SHA-256 bucketing and kill switches, role-to-purpose data access with consent and masking, a hash-chained append-only audit log, and a canary versus baseline comparison on error rate and p95. OpenTelemetry is optional.

Built and maintained by Art Akopian, CEO of Banrox (https://banrox.com).

## Docs

- [README.md](https://github.com/BanroxArt/live-codebase/blob/main/README.md): What is in the service, how to run it, and the design notes.
- [docs/rollout.md](https://github.com/BanroxArt/live-codebase/blob/main/docs/rollout.md): How a change moves from a merged PR to all users, including canary and rollback.
- [docs/benchmarks.md](https://github.com/BanroxArt/live-codebase/blob/main/docs/benchmarks.md): Timeit measurements for the hot paths.
- [SKILL.md](https://github.com/BanroxArt/live-codebase/blob/main/SKILL.md): Agent skill for taking one service through the same loops.

## Source

- [app.py](https://github.com/BanroxArt/live-codebase/blob/main/src/livesvc/app.py): WSGI app wiring.
- [server.py](https://github.com/BanroxArt/live-codebase/blob/main/src/livesvc/server.py): Public and admin listeners and SIGTERM drain.
- [health.py](https://github.com/BanroxArt/live-codebase/blob/main/src/livesvc/health.py): `/healthz` and time-boxed, non-piling `/readyz` checks.
- [logs.py](https://github.com/BanroxArt/live-codebase/blob/main/src/livesvc/logs.py): JSON logs with request and trace ids, and redaction.
- [tracing.py](https://github.com/BanroxArt/live-codebase/blob/main/src/livesvc/tracing.py): W3C `traceparent` parse/emit, spans, sampling, optional OTel mirror.
- [metrics.py](https://github.com/BanroxArt/live-codebase/blob/main/src/livesvc/metrics.py): Counters and histograms in Prometheus text format.
- [flags.py](https://github.com/BanroxArt/live-codebase/blob/main/src/livesvc/flags.py): Deterministic percentage rollouts, allow/deny lists, kill switches, hot reload.
- [auth.py](https://github.com/BanroxArt/live-codebase/blob/main/src/livesvc/auth.py): Bearer tokens; the caller's role decides purpose and fields.
- [data.py](https://github.com/BanroxArt/live-codebase/blob/main/src/livesvc/data.py): Purpose-based field access, consent, masking and per-read audit.
- [audit.py](https://github.com/BanroxArt/live-codebase/blob/main/src/livesvc/audit.py): Append-only, hash-chained access log with a verifier.
- [canary.py](https://github.com/BanroxArt/live-codebase/blob/main/src/livesvc/canary.py): Canary vs baseline comparison; promote, hold or rollback.
